scientific.finding:
For every real \(\ell_q(I)\) with at least two coordinates, \(1\le q\le\infty\), and every Gao exponent \(r\ge1\), let \(q'\) be the Hölder conjugate and \(s=\min\{q,q'\}\), with endpoint conventions \(1'=\infty\) and \(\infty'=1\). Then
\[
c_{\mathrm{NJ}}^{(r)}(\ell_q(I))=
\begin{cases}
1,&1\le r\le s,\\
2^{1-r/s},&r\ge s.
\end{cases}
\]
Here \(c_{\mathrm{NJ}}^{(r)}(X)=\inf_{x,y\in S_X}(\|x+y\|^r+\|x-y\|^r)/2^r\). Thus the exact phase transition occurs at \(r=\min\{q,q'\}\).
scientific.integrity: The global formula is proved analytically from Clarkson inequalities, duality, and sharp two-dimensional norm comparison. The packaged numerical checker is corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: Real classical \(\ell_q\) spaces with at least two coordinates; no complex-scalar or nonclassical lattice extension is claimed. An obscure equivalent formulation outside the inspected sources remains a residual originality risk.
